rules: A source-supplied evidence state controls interpretation when present.
Blank value without a source state is missing, never suppressed by inference.
Suppressed, unresolved, not-published, and missing are distinct from numeric zero.
Measure labels and grains must remain explicit in product responses.
Income-band net-price measures are published institutional averages and must never be presented as personalized aid estimates or adjusted for household size without a separate authoritative method.
